theorems.name: Submission.sobolev_level_energy_tonelli
theorems.statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (μ : Measure (Ambient n ℓ)) (h D K : Ambient n ℓ → ℝ) (γ : ℝ → ℝ), IsFiniteMeasureOnCompacts μ → Continuous h → HasCompactSupport h → (∀ x, 0 ≤ h x) → (∀ x, 0 ≤ D x) → Integrable D μ → (∀ x, 0 ≤ K x) → IntegrableOn K (tsupport h) μ → ContDiff ℝ 1 γ → Monotone γ → (∀ s, 0 ≤ γ s ∧ γ s ≤ 1) → (∀ s, s ≤ 0 → γ s = 0) → ∫⁻ t in Ioi (0 : ℝ), ENNReal.ofReal ((∫ x, deriv γ (h x - t) * D x ∂μ) + ∫ x in {x | t < h x}, K x ∂μ) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (∫ x, (D x + h x * K x) ∂μ)
